purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: USTDA Project Development Pipeline — 2026
question: What did the seven USTDA project-development objects published September 21–25, 2026 actually fund or initiate, which later decisions could their work products shape, and what evidence would establish adoption, financing, procurement, construction or operation?
bluf: Seven USTDA objects support work products that can become inputs to later public and commercial decisions: regulatory and institutional roadmaps, legal documents, tender packages, environmental assessments, financial models, procurement criteria, technical designs and demand forecasts. Marshall Islands, Vietnam and Ecuador name selected U.S. contractors; Nigeria and Lobito expose active RFPs; Türkiye and the Buenassa DRC refinery remain at signed-agreement or future-procurement stage. None of the seven announcements establishes an accepted final study, adopted downstream rule, financing close, EPC or equipment award, construction notice, commissioning or operation.
evidence_cutoff_note: The package reconciles seven official USTDA project announcements published September 21–25, 2026 with available recipient, contractor and procurement records. Agreement, contractor procurement, accepted work product, recipient decision, financing, procurement or delivery, and operation or effect remain separate gates.
use_note: Use for the seven-project USTDA development pipeline and its exact return gates. Keep USTDA agreement, recipient procurement, accepted final work product, recipient adoption, financing, EPC or equipment award, construction, commissioning and operation separate. Registration does not authorize Chronicle promotion, a watch, app/site shipment, commit or push.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
